subject: Training-on-customer-data opt-out confirmation - Acme Inc.
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Training-on-customer-data opt-out confirmation - Acme Inc.

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the time on the call earlier — quick recap and next steps on the data handling items we discussed:

- Training/model improvement: You requested that Acme Inc. content not be used to train or improve our models (full opt-out).
- PII handling: We'll scope options for redaction at ingestion and recommend tokenization/PII scrubbers where possible.
- Retention: Default logs/token cache retention is 30 days; we can propose a shorter retention window and provide an SLA-backed retention addendum.
- Audit/logging: Access logs and per-request metadata are available; full payload logging can be disabled or masked on your dedicated account.
- Data residency: We can pin your tenant to the us-west region for both runtime and persisted artifacts.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm via reply that Acme Inc. opts out of training-on-customer-data for all environments (hosted/dedicated/private).
2) Once confirmed we'll raise an internal change (DEAL-ACME-202705) to disable the training flag and provide a DocuSign addendum for signatures.
3) I'll loop in Marissa for the formal DPA and Rishi for technical details on masking/retention.

Attachments: redwood-dpa.pdf, security-whitepaper.pdf (stubs)
DocuSign (provisioned after confirmation): https://na1.docusign.net/sign/ACME-OPT-OUT

Short ask: Can you confirm the opt-out language below by EOD today?
"Acme Inc. opts out of Redwood Inference using customer-provided content to train, fine-tune, or improve models."

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0197
From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@acmeinc.com>

Date: 2027-05-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Training-on-customer-data opt-out confirmation - Acme Inc.

Jordan,

Thanks for the recap — we confirm that Acme Inc. wants a full opt-out: Acme Inc. opts out of Redwood Inference using customer-provided content to train, fine-tune, or improve models.

A couple of follow-ups:
- Retention: We need logs retained for at least 90 days for our audit team. Is that possible?
- Logging: Can you confirm whether request/response payloads are stored in plaintext in hosted mode, or if you offer masking/PII redaction at ingestion?
- DocuSign: Please send the addendum. Our legal (Samantha) should be on the signature chain.

Thanks,
Alex

Date: 2027-05-22T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Training-on-customer-data opt-out confirmation - Acme Inc.

Alex / Samantha,

Confirmed — thank you. Official confirmation received: we will apply a full opt-out for Acme Inc. across all environments.

Details / answers to your questions:
- Opt-out action: We'll flip the tenant-level flag that prevents any customer content from being used for model training or improvement. This is applied account-wide for Acme Inc. (hosted and dedicated).
- Retention: We can set your audit/log retention to 90 days as requested; I've opened a ticket to extend your retention window and will confirm when complete.
- Payload logging & masking: By default, hosted mode stores request/response payloads for up to 30 days for troubleshooting. For Acme Inc. we'll disable full payload persistence and enable metadata-only logging. We also offer ingestion-time PII redaction and recommend enabling it for tokens that may contain sensitive identifiers.
- Data residency & keys: We'll pin your tenant to us-west; for Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS/HSM. If you need an SOC2 w/ encryption attestation, see attached.

Attachments: redwood-dpa.pdf, security-whitepaper.pdf
DocuSign: https://na1.docusign.net/sign/ACME-OPT-OUT
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/AcmeInc

I've looped in Marissa to send the DPA addendum for signature and Rishi to coordinate the technical changes. Expect the DocuSign link within the hour.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
